summary_1line: Aswatthaman unleashes the Narayana weapon after vowing revenge for Drona, devastating the Pandava army and terrifying Yudhishthira.

image_candidates.scene_text: Aswatthaman stands in his chariot invoking the Narayana weapon as thousands of flaming arrows and celestial weapons fill the darkened sky.
A ghastly mountain of corpses rises on the battlefield—chariot standards like trees, weapons like peaks, elephants like rocks beneath circling carrion birds.
Yudhishthira watches in horror as the Pandava army burns under the storm of divine missiles raining from every direction.
